headline.text: L3 ML1 line stopped after *8 consecutive* temper readings at -0.8 — adjustments underway to bring chocolate back to spec.

summary: Two quality issues at L3 required line stoppages for adjustment: ML1 temper trending low, MF Matrix running underweight. L1 S3 decorator overflowed despite closed valve; crew cleaned. No active holds or food-safety events.

quality.title: ML1 temper running low — line stopped for adjustment
quality.summary: 8 consecutive temper readings at -0.8 triggered line stop at 06:34; team adjusting water jacket to 89°F, mixing water to 84°F, cold water to 58°F to bring chocolate back into spec.
quality.status: Open — operator making temperature adjustments, line down as of window close.

quality.title: MF Matrix weight issues flagged
quality.summary: Line running out of spec on weight; maintenance notified and making adjustments to production line.
quality.status: Open — adjustments in progress as of 06:40.

quality.title: MF Matrix lot and date code corrected
quality.summary: Lot and date coding error identified and corrected during shift.

sanitation.title: S3 decorator overflow despite closed valve
sanitation.summary: Decorator overflowed even with valve closed; crew cleaned the affected area.

opportunities.text: Review S3 decorator valve and overflow protection — today's overflow despite a closed valve suggests a mechanical fault that could repeat.
Consider adding temper trend monitoring to ML1 startup checks — today's 8 consecutive low readings suggest the drift started earlier than the line stop.
